msg: At the start of the game choose the gnomes on each match up you will stick with, stick with them and if one of them starts to consistently give less than 5 mushrooms switch to the other, "consistently" meaning 2 or 3 in a row, the maximum seems to be 9 and the minimum is 0 mushrooms, I got around 2000 so if you get far below it's bad and far above seems to be good. The average mushrooms I got on each one was around 6 but I had a lot of 9s 8s and 7s. It is better to choose the wrong gnome then to not choose one
